title: Weekly sync - serving runtime / infra / console - prep + action items (2026-04-13)
content:
Meeting: Weekly cross-team sync (serving runtime / infra / console) - personal prep notes
Date: 2026-04-13 | Time: 10:00-10:30 PT | Owner: Priya Shah (prep)
Purpose: align on rollout/pipeline stability items, infra cost pressure, console UX for model routing, and unblock the canary rollout for v2.1.

Agenda (30m)
- Quick status (3m)
  - Prod latency: p95 increased from 210ms -> 260ms for long-context (8k) models last 48h
  - Error budget usage: infra team reports 7% toward monthly SLO (was 4% last week)
- Serving runtime: long-context perf regression investigation (8m)
  - Recent kernel changes merged on main (PR #214) — need confirmation on perf test coverage
  - Action: run dedicated perf-job on rw-test-cluster (8k seq) with new kernels vs canary
- Infra/capacity: autoscaler tuning + cost mitigation (6m)
  - Observed higher pod churn during burst traffic -> possible aggressive downscale window
  - Action: try extending scale-down window from 2m -> 6m for burst-prone routes (A/B on dedicated pool)
- Console/rollouts: canary rollout for v2.1 and UX for fallback policy (6m)
  - Need final decision on rollout policy: 10% traffic for 48h with auto-rollback on CPU spike
  - Action: console team to add rollback email alert and expose manual cutoff in UI
- Action item review + blockers (5m)

Notes / details to bring up
- Perf regression timeline: regression showed up after kernel selector change (2026-04-09 deploy). We should correlate with KV cache hit rates and batching latency.
- Repro: local perf harness reproduces increased decode time when sequence length >6k under continuous-batching. Might be related to new attention kernel fallback for certain layer shapes.
- Observability: add a temporary trace tag for kernel version on hot paths so we can filter traces by kernel id in Honeycomb.
- Autoscaler: current policy aggressively scales down based on 60s observation window; churn correlates with short bursts from route x-analytics. Longer window will increase cost slightly but reduce cold starts.
- Console: canary UI currently lacks a clear override option; PM asked for manual kill switch + justification note for audit logs.

Open questions
- Who owns kernel version tagging in traces? (ask SRE/observability)
- If we extend scale-down window to 6m, what's the estimated monthly cost delta for dedicated pool A? Request infra finance calc.
- Is the current rollback threshold (CPU 75% for 3m) the right signal? Should we use request latency p99 instead?

Action items (tracked)
- ACTION-01: Run 8k-seq perf job comparing main vs canary kernels (priority: high) | Owner: Liam O'Connor | Due: 2026-04-14 | Status: in_progress | Notes: Liam to provision job on rw-test-cluster; use sample set `longseq-2026-04`
- ACTION-02: Add kernel-version tag to traces for inference hot paths | Owner: Evelyn Chen | Due: 2026-04-15 | Status: todo | Notes: small shim in runtime to push version metadata into trace context; coordinate with observability for schema
- ACTION-03: Extend autoscaler scale-down window to 6m for route `x-analytics` in dedicated pool A (A/B test) | Owner: Mateo Ruiz | Due: 2026-04-16 | Status: todo | Notes: run for 72h and measure pod churn and cold-start latency
- ACTION-04: Console: add manual rollout cutoff + rollback email alert for canaries | Owner: Priya Shah (console PM lead) | Due: 2026-04-17 | Status: todo | Notes: minimal UI + backend flag; ensure audit log entry includes operator and note
- ACTION-05: Finance estimate for cost delta if scale-down window extended (monthly) | Owner: finance-team (cc: Mateo) | Due: 2026-04-15 | Status: requested | Notes: ask for +/- range; if >8% need exec approval

Previous action item check (from 2026-04-06 notes)
- Prev-A1: Verify KV cache eviction policy for multi-tenant routes (Owner: Evelyn) -> Done (2026-04-09) ; Result: eviction threshold adjusted to 72h
- Prev-A2: Healthchecks for canary model variants (Owner: Priya) -> In progress; health webhook added but alerting not wired

Blockers to escalate
- Observability schema change required to accept kernel-version tag; may need infra change window (ask SRE)
- Finance estimate turnaround (needed to decide on scale window this week)

Prep notes for sync leads (what to say)
- Ask runtime: "Can you repro locally? Have you run the perf job and what are the differences in decode time?"
- Ask infra: "Can we get a quick cost ballpark for scale-down window change?"
- Ask console: "Can we ship a minimal manual cutoff and rollback alert this week to avoid blocking canary rollout?"

Post-meeting follow-up (personal)
- Update action-tracker doc with final owners + dates (after meeting)
- Schedule short follow-up 1:1 with Evelyn to unblock trace tagging (15m)
- If perf job shows regression >10% p95, draft rollback plan for v2.1 and notify success-oncall

Quick links to bring
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/214
- Perf harness job template: //ci.internal/perf/jobs/longseq-8k
- Canary rollout plan (draft): https://confluence.internal/redwood/canary-rollout-v2-1

Personal todo after sync
- Add action items to shared tracker (make sure ticket IDs created)
- Ping finance for cost estimate
- Kick off trace-tagging sync with observability

End of notes
